headline: NYY @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.17 at BOS 3.80, with a projected total of 7.98. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: NYY moved -0.34 runs while BOS moved -0.14, changing the projected margin by -0.20 runs. The projected total fell -0.48, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Sonny Gray has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Caleb Durbin, Ceddanne Rafaela, Paul Goldschmidt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jarren Duran, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
